exposure: History of two previous lower segment cesarean sections (LSCS)
Acute on chronic pelvic inflammatory disease (PID)
outcome: Extensive pelvic pathology identified on imaging
Need for aggressive and comprehensive treatment
cohort: A 32-year-old woman, gravida 2 para 2, with a history of two previous lower segment cesarean sections (LSCS) presenting with acute on chronic pelvic inflammatory disease.
finding: The case highlights the importance of timely diagnosis and aggressive management of acute on chronic pelvic inflammatory disease, particularly when extensive pelvic pathology and systemic signs of sepsis are present, to prevent complications.
